attributes.storage_note: Keep in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Ensure the cap is tightly closed after each use. Store in an upright position to prevent spillage.

sources.note: Blinkit product page. Read from the page's own labelled fields, never from its marketing copy. No price or availability is taken.
